channel.title: Wire — tech digest
channel.description: One digest a day, merged from thirty sources.

item.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
item.description: I’ve been self-hosting things for many years. There were times when I was quite enthusiastic about it, constantly trying out new software and tinkering with my infrastructure. But at some point, that enthusiasm faded a bit. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Mozilla Partners with Mistral to Bring Open-Weight AI Models to Firefox Smart Window
item.description: Mozilla has partnered with Mistral AI to offer Mistral Small 4, an open-weight model, in Firefox's Smart Window AI assistant, now in beta. It is recommended for users in France, the US and Canada. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight
item.description: PyTorch now lets an AI reviewer approve pull requests from its own maintainers. GreenLight is an open-source take on RADAR, the system Meta uses to auto-land low-risk diffs after safety checks, a risk score and an LLM review. (1 source: infoq)
